summary: QP-1 v1 (Quarterly Pacing) MVP fully tested — 14/14 backend endpoints pass and full frontend flow (pacing/week/schedules tabs, dashboard tile, ad-hoc, confirm) works end-to-end for cathy@example.com. OJ-1 regression: envelope tile still visible; journey-start banner not shown on this account (journey already started).

issues: QP-1 dashboard tile + OJ-1 envelope tile both visible; content is a bit redundant (per main-agent note this is acceptable UX polish for follow-up, not a bug).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/qp1.py line 191-203 _pace_status returns 'underspend' but spec §9 notes underspend is a *flag* separate from status — the code correctly emits both (pacing.pace_status + underspend_flag). Frontend uses pace_status value to render qp1-pace-card-underspend which is fine.

ledger _mutate_ledger only checks ownership via the schedule owner; ad_hoc entries (schedule_id=None) skip the ownership check entirely. Malicious authenticated user could still confirm/mutate someone else's ad_hoc entry. Recommend adding a participant→owner check (or storing user_id on the ledger row).

auto_assume endpoint has no admin gate — any authenticated user can trigger a global state transition for ALL participants when participant_id is omitted. Consider requiring admin role or forcing participant_id.

list_ledger and pacing endpoints do not verify participant ownership — an authenticated user can pass any participant_id and read that participant's ledger/pacing. Recommend joining via participants collection + user_id.
get_by_role button 'Sign in' — login form uses standard patterns; no issue.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created a TEST_Cleaning weekly schedule (later ended). UI test created an additional TEST_Cleaning_UI schedule and a TEST_UI_Adhoc ledger entry that remain on Dorothy's household for cathy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: QP-1 verified end-to-end iter86. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_qp1.py runs 14 tests in ~24s using cathy account. Ownership loopholes noted (ad_hoc mutations, cross-participant reads, auto_assume without admin gate) — recommend addressing before v1.5.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocked the feature. Ownership loopholes are hardening items, not blockers for MVP demo.
